'''Ulaire Cantea Watch Your Step, the Floor is Wet''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Ulaire Cantea]]
* '''Published:''' 4 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif|label=Watch Your Step}}
* '''Strategy:''' Watch Your Step
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed WYS Cantea LS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Strategy ==

Start the stuff, play sites, pull kessel, drop Dash in ship there, use mirax to set up destinies, Get the ULTIMATE BEATDOWN FORCE:
Han with Blaster
Chewie, Enraged
Artoo & Threepio
Luke JK at an adjacent site
Initiate, bad feeling, run luke run, shoot, dont get cocky.

Also, dont get cocky, not the card, but dont leave things open.  Anticipate the opponents moves.  Use the force.

Emerson "Sparkz" Sklar
Ulaire Cantea

NOTE: The floor is wet refers to water, not something else.... Also, the ULTIMATE BEATDOWN actually happens. I did it to a friend in a tourney, made them lose 75 force in that one battle.
